thread:
Mike: Quick async standup for the Acme closing readiness — doing a short pass on pipeline / blockers / security asks.

Mike: Yesterday — pushed final dedicated pilot config to staging, walked through SOW with legal, demo scheduled with Acme on Friday.
Mike: Blockers — need confirmation from security on BYOK/KMS keywrap approach (they asked for HSM-backed wrap). Also waiting on PO from finance; Luis said ~EOD.
Mike: Today — finish runbook for the pilot handoff, add canary fallback rule in deployment, and prep slide for Friday demo.

Tara: FYI I reviewed pilot config, left 2 small comments in the PR about env var names and retention. I can merge once Priya signs off on key policy. :+1:

Josh: For the canary fallback, I sketched a policy that routes to a smaller quantized variant on capacity pressure — drop a diff in #eng-runtime in a bit.

Priya: Re: KMS/HSM — we can do customer-managed keys but Acme requires HSM-backed wrapping in the threat model. Need to confirm whether they want BYOK import or external wrap.
Priya: Quick checklist for security approval:
```
- Confirm BYOK import method
- Determine key lifecycle / rotation window
- Logging requirements (audit retention 1y?)
- Network egress constraints for KMS calls
```
Priya: If we get the BYOK import path confirmed I can greenlight the pilot by Thursday.

Luis: PO status — finance is queueing approvals, I pushed for priority. Expect a signed PO by close of business today (or earliest tomorrow morning). Will DM if anything shifts.

Mike: @Priya good call on logging retention, Acme asked for 12 months in their DPA. Also they flagged that KMS calls should stay inside their VPC via private link.

Priya: OK, I'll update the security checklist: audit retention = 12 months, require VPC endpoint. That means we should confirm whether Dedicated or Private deployment is the target.

Tara: Acme asked for Dedicated in the call last week, but they also want an option to move to Private later. I'll note that in the runbook.

Mike: Small ops ask: can someone add a short snippet to the runbook for a manual rollback? e.g., how to pin model version and flip routing.

Josh: Adding rollback snippet now — will paste here when done.

Josh: ```
# Manual rollback (high-level)
1) Update route policy to pin model->previous-stable
2) Scale down new pool: rl scale --pool acme-pilot --replicas=0
3) Monitor latency/errors via console for 10m
4) If OK, remove canary config and alert stakeholder
```

Mike: Perfect.

Priya: One more thing — Acme's security team wants an HSM attestation doc. I have a template; can we add our HSM provider page and include the keywrap flow? I'll need a short architecture diagram (1 slide).

Tara: I can draft the slide today, will ping for review.

Luis: Once PO lands, I'll trigger the billing/commit setup and send the onboarding invoice link.

DeployBot: deploy_status: staging -> success (commit 9f3a2b) :rocket:

Mike: Thanks all. Next sync Friday after the demo; for now please thumbs up when you finish the checklist items so I can mark green in the tracker. :thumbsup:

Tara: 👍
Priya: 👍
